title: Bledsoe memoir names Taylor as a NASA insider

tellings.quote: >> And outside of her account, super experiencer Chris Bledso's memoir openly names Taylor as a NASA insider who befriended him after his encounters.

plain: A man named Chris Bledsoe, who describes many encounters with beings he calls otherworldly, wrote a memoir that openly names a man called Timothy Taylor as an insider at NASA, the US space agency, who befriended him after those encounters. Michels says this himself to back up another person's account of Taylor. It matters because it would place a space agency figure close to people who report such contact.
